title: Kicked Creamy Greek Lamb Tagine
description: A sweet and creamy Mediterranean dish featuring candied peel and kombu cold extract, perfect for curing hangovers, this recipe is gluten free friendly and cooked to perfection on a slate tile vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the lamb pieces with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and dried oregano until they are evenly coated.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium high heat and sear the lamb pieces until they are browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the candied peel, kombu cold extract, and heavy cream to the pot, stirring to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven, where it will cook for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional candied peel if desired.
